answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy gives each newcomer a probation bond locked for 22 epochs. Three randomly selected auditors reproduce distinct tasks; a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. A crystal sponsor quota allows only two new identities per epoch, while a canyon registry compares signed output fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Full rewards unlock after seven clean rounds, making fake identities costly and slow; cedar task hashes keep decisions auditable.
